title: The Three Little Pigs: short story for beginners
description: Read the full text of The Three Little Pigs. Tap a word to see its meaning. Level A1, about 3 minutes. A kind, easy story for new English learners.
intro: Three pig brothers leave home and build three very different houses, but a hungry wolf is watching them. The sentences are short and clear, so the old tale is easy to follow at A1 level.
